decisions.detail: No operation-specific equation black boxes; rescue references and generic tools first.

decisions.detail: One owner per file; the roadmap is the single channel between agents.

decisions.detail: Consolidate nonspatial thermodynamics first; keep existing spatial behavior.

decisions.title: UNIFAC has full priority; NRTL is not extended
decisions.detail: Experimental UNIFAC contrast is deferred to the end.

decisions.title: Rebuild or delete the laboratory
decisions.detail: Blocks deleting the legacy side completely.
